specification_notes: Defines holdout quotas and disjoint source families for post-freeze judge calibration and reliability assessment. Item-level curation, packaging, and cryptographic hashing must be performed independently by an external human panel prior to unsealing. Seals and attestations remain null/PENDING until real curated content is hashed to prevent fabricating holdout integrity.
synthetic_data_policy: STRICTLY_PROHIBITED: Synthetic holdout data must NEVER be generated and labeled as independently curated. Curated holdout items must originate exclusively from verified external human panel sources with documented provenance.

rq2_experimental_corpus_distinction.judge_holdout_scope: 30-item post-freeze evaluator reliability check (18 reading, 12 grammar questions)
rq2_experimental_corpus_distinction.rq2_final_eval_scope: 25-40 paired benchmark tasks per domain (25-40 Reading tasks, 25-40 Grammar tasks across Arms A, B, C; 150-240 total assigned slots)
rq2_experimental_corpus_distinction.relationship: DISJOINT: The 30-item judge holdout measures post-freeze evaluator calibration; it cannot substitute for, overlap with, or fulfill the 25-40 paired tasks per domain required for RQ2 hypothesis testing.
